components.name: Accepted transaction indexer
components.why: Accepted transaction listening is a live builder surface and can derive app state from accepted mainnet payments.
components.next: Build a network-configurable indexer that can run against mainnet without TN12 fixtures.

components.name: Invoice / payload receipts
components.why: Standard transactions can carry app payload data, but this repo still needs a verified payload-preserving submit route.
components.next: Finish the accepted payload receipt vertical slice before any real merchant workflow.

components.name: Access passes / coupons
components.why: Issuer/indexer-backed claims can work as app state without native covenant enforcement.
components.next: Tie one redemption to an accepted payload receipt and keep issuer enforcement visible.

components.name: Attestation registry
components.why: Signed statements anchored to accepted transactions can be useful app-layer records.
components.next: Add signature material and accepted payload receipts for one signal.

components.name: Wallet-facing submit console
components.why: Reviewing signed drafts is useful, but local key files and shell submit commands are not a production wallet flow.
components.next: Move from local draft review to wallet connector review without exposing private keys.

components.name: Vault covenant templates
components.why: Silverscript/covenant proof transactions are TN12-only until Toccata is active on mainnet and tooling is final.
components.next: Keep as TN12 proof and add adversarial tests for current script paths.

components.name: Assurance pledge primitive
components.why: The current script is an individual TN12 pledge primitive and does not enforce campaign target aggregation.
components.next: Continue from batch planner to exact settlement drafts without claiming full assurance contract enforcement.

components.name: Escrow primitive
components.why: Current escrow has accepted TN12 release and DAA-refund proofs, but remains TN12/Toccata-only and unaudited.
blockers: cancel path proof on a separate output
components.next: Fund a separate escrow output for mutual-cancel proof, then add negative tests before discussing mainnet.

components.name: Hashdag/Staghunt-style coordination markets
components.why: The repo has a transparent toy Stag/Intendo/Pack/Solver/Hunt planner, not opacity, multiplexing, composability, or atomic execution.
components.next: Keep the toy solver transparent and build exact settlement drafts for one pack before stronger claims.
